description: Over-representation analysis (ORA): which gene sets hold more of a gene list than chance, by the one-sided hypergeometric test against a background, as clusterProfiler's enricher() runs it (enrichit 0.2.6). Reports gene and background ratios, fold enrichment, odds ratio, z-score, p, adjusted p and Storey q-value per set, and which sets pass both cutoffs. Every tested set is bit-identical to enrichit in R on pasilla's DE genes against every fly GO term.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

forceUniverse.description: use `universe` as given instead of intersecting it with the annotated genes.

geneSets.description: the gene sets, as GMT text (MSigDB, GO or WikiPathways exports): one set per line, tab-separated ID, description, then member gene IDs. IDs must be the same kind as the genes'.

genes.description: the gene list (e.g. the significant genes of a DE run), one ID per line or separated by commas or spaces.

maxGSSize.description: largest set tested, counted within the background.

minGSSize.description: smallest set tested, counted within the background.

pAdjustMethod.description: multiple-testing adjustment across the tested sets (R `p.adjust`).

pvalueCutoff.description: a set is enriched when p and adjusted p are at most this.

qvalueCutoff.description: and its q-value at most this.

universe.description: the background: every gene the experiment could have called (e.g. a DE run's tested genes). Empty is every gene any set annotates, clusterProfiler's default.

weights.description: per-gene sampling weights, 'gene weight' per line (e.g. a DESeq2 run's mean normalized counts, `meanCounts`, or gene lengths): replaces the hypergeometric test with Wallenius' noncentral one (BiasedUrn), each set's odds being its members' mean weight over the rest of the background's, so a set of well-counted or long genes is not called for being easy to detect. Background genes without a weight take the median; weights at or below 0 are lifted to the smallest positive one. Empty is the unweighted test.

name: gene_set_overrepresentation

enriched.description: the sets passing the p, adjusted-p and q cutoffs

summary.description: input genes, how many are in the background, the background size, sets supplied, in the size range and tested, and the q-value route

terms.description: every tested set, by p: count, set size, gene and background ratios, fold enrichment, odds ratio, z-score, p, adjusted p, q-value, the hit genes
